system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:59:06 UTC, a Windows 4648 event on WS-RIYER-01 records SYSTEM running taskhostw.exe using explicit credentials for svc-reporting, targeting DC-LV-01.
The event records one credential-use event; by itself it does not establish that a domain logon failed or that repeated failures occurred.
The observed source host, WS-RIYER-01, differs from FILE-LV-01, where the inventory says the ReportSync job runs; this is a discrepancy to investigate, not proof of malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: According to the supplied sensor coverage status, DC-LV-01 and FILE-LV-01 Security and Sysmon events were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to a Windows Event Forwarding collector outage.
Only one authentication-related event record was provided for the review window, so the alert's claim of repeated failed logons cannot be verified from the available records.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-reporting authentication attempt succeeded or failed.
Whether there were repeated failed domain logons involving svc-reporting during the review window.
Why svc-reporting credentials were used from WS-RIYER-01, or whether that activity was authorized.
Whether the scheduled password rotation or ReportSync job update explains the event.
Whether other authentication, process, or network activity on DC-LV-01 or FILE-LV-01 was related.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover and review local Security and Sysmon logs from DC-LV-01 and FILE-LV-01 for 13:20–14:20 UTC, especially the uncollected 13:30–14:10 interval.
Obtain domain controller authentication events for svc-reporting, including success/failure status, source host, and any repeated attempts.
Review WS-RIYER-01 Security and process telemetry around 13:59 UTC to determine what caused taskhostw.exe to use svc-reporting credentials.
Review CHG-2291 execution records and FILE-LV-01 ReportSync job configuration and run history to establish whether the password rotation and job update occurred as scheduled.
